title: Not Bad
body: The app itself is basic and not bad, but I’ve paid for premium and can’t add a widget to my phone. I’ve contacted the developers several times and had no response. Paying for nothing is annoying.
author: MegsieP

body: Paid for premium and then when they updated the app they asked me to pay subscription.
author: SCAM!.

title: Meh
body: Good app, but I bought premium and when they changed their premium package they cancelled my membership and asked me to pay for the new amount... very disappointing
author: Jomiro Eming
